CREATE TABLE task_learning_target (
    task_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES task(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    target_type varchar(32) NOT NULL,
    target_key varchar(255) NOT NULL,
    target_version varchar(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    "order" integer NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (task_id, target_type, target_key, target_version),
    UNIQUE (task_id, "order"),
    CONSTRAINT task_learning_target_type_check CHECK (target_type IN ('concept', 'capability')),
    CONSTRAINT task_learning_target_key_check CHECK (
        target_key ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._:/-]*$'
        AND target_key !~ '(^|/)\.{1,2}(/|$)'
        AND target_key !~ '(^/|/$|//)'
    ),
    CONSTRAINT task_learning_target_order_check CHECK ("order" >= 0)
);

CREATE INDEX task_learning_target_lookup_idx
    ON task_learning_target (target_type, target_key, target_version);
